title: Continuous-Time Set-Transformers for Asynchronous WiFi-IMU Indoor Localization
abstract: arXiv:2611.13057v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Indoor localization commonly combines WiFi received signal strength indicator (RSSI) fingerprints with inertial measurements. However, these sensor streams are sampled asynchronously at different rates; therefore, observations rarely align in time and may be missing or stale. Most existing methods resample the data onto a shared clock and process each modality using a separate branch. We instead present a continuous-time transformer that represents observations as an unordered set of timestamped tokens. Each token encodes its measurement, modality, and elapsed time since acquisition. A single attention block jointly fuses information across modalities and time, avoiding both resampling and modality-specific branches while remaining invariant to token order. translated_title: 用于异步WiFi-IMU室内定位的连续时间集合变换器
translated_abstract: 室内定位通常将WiFi接收信号强度指示器（RSSI）指纹与惯性测量相结合。然而，这些传感器流以不同的速率异步采样，因此观测值很少在时间上对齐，且可能缺失或过时。大多数现有方法将数据重新采样到共享时钟上，并使用单独的分支处理每个模态。我们转而提出一种连续时间变换器，将观测值表示为一组无序的带时间戳的标记。每个标记编码其测量值、模态以及自采集以来经过的时间。单个注意力块跨模态和时间联合融合信息，既避免了重新采样，也避免了特定模态的分支，同时保持对标记顺序的不变性。在训练期间，我们随机屏蔽整个模态和单个观测值，使模型能够在缺失或过时输入的情况下运行。我们验证了模态特定的…
tldr: 提出一种连续时间集合变换器，将异步采样的WiFi与IMU观测表示为带时间戳的无序标记集合，用单一注意力块实现跨模态与时间的联合融合，并通过随机掩码训练应对缺失或过时的传感器输入，用于室内定位。
en_tdlr: A continuous-time set-transformer represents asynchronous WiFi and IMU observations as unordered timestamped tokens, fusing modalities and time via a single attention block, with random masking during training to handle missing or stale inputs for indoor localization.
